name: CheapShark
tagline: Free game deal aggregator with price alerts and historical lows
description: CheapShark aggregates digital game deals across major stores (Steam, Epic, GOG, and more), exposing current prices, historical lows, store metadata, and email-based price alerts. The public REST API requires no API key for core deal and game lookups, making it popular for price-tracking bots, deal dashboards, and wishlist tools.

auth.details: No API key required for public REST endpoints; requests are made directly to the open API.

use_cases: find current lowest prices for a PC game across digital stores
list top deals under a price cap on Steam or other stores
look up a game's historical low and deal history by game ID
set or manage email price alerts for a wishlist game
fetch store metadata and active store IDs for deal filtering
